/look_brief.audience: Corrin Medical's board: non-executive directors including a former device-company chief executive, an audit chair who checks every figure, and two investor directors who will be asked to approve $165m of spend
/look_brief.occasion: an eight-page board pre-read sent a week ahead and read on laptops and tablets at the reader's pace, then put on the boardroom screen while the chief executive takes questions; every page has to stand alone without the speaker
/look_brief.subject_world: device makers live by quality-system conventions: the ISO 14971 risk matrix with its acceptable, ALARP and unacceptable zones, numbered steps in instructions for use, design-control gates as milestones and the boxed label codes on packaging. The deck borrows the conventions that do a job here: the three-zone risk matrix, numbered process steps, gates named M1 to M6 on the roadmap. It leaves out red crosses, stethoscopes, hospital photography and clinical blue gradients, which would be costume
/look_brief.data_character: a full transformation case: eight KPIs with baselines and targets, a seven-step process with six costed pain points, seven plants with capacity and headcount, fourteen initiatives scored on value and ease, a seven-step EBITDA bridge with three years of phasing and a cash case, a 13-row roadmap with six milestones and three dependencies, a two-level organisation, and nine risks scored before and after mitigation; one dominant exhibit per page, each with a supporting table or panel

density.target: dense, banker-grade: one dominant exhibit plus one supporting table or panel per page, tables of 7 to 14 rows at 7.5pt, a claim title of up to two lines and a source line on every page
density.why: directors read the pre-read line by line before approving spend and want each claim and the figures behind it on one page; a sparse deck would push the evidence into an appendix they will not open

/look_brief.look: clinical-plain and numerate: white pages, near-black Inter, one deep petrol blue for Corrin's own figures and target state, a grey-blue for today's baseline, a burnt orange that marks only where the reader must look; hairline-ruled tables, a petrol rule under a sentence title, and a footer carrying the Corrin mark

colour_meanings.color.accent1: Corrin's own figures, the target state and the page structure: the title rule, table heads, totals in the bridge, the delivery phase, retained sites, initiatives started in the plan
colour_meanings.color.accent2: the preparatory stage of a plan: the design phase of an initiative on the roadmap
colour_meanings.color.accent3: today's baseline and context that recedes: FY2025 values, deferred initiatives
colour_meanings.color.emphasis: where the reader must look: pain points, the step that dominates the cycle, sites that close and their transfers, the strategic bets, milestones and gates, new units, the transformation levers' bracket
colour_meanings.color.positive: an increase in the bridge and nothing else: a mid petrol, kin to Corrin's own colour
colour_meanings.color.negative: a decrease in the bridge and nothing else: a warm grey, so a headwind recedes beside the levers
colour_meanings.color.zone_low: the acceptable zone of the risk matrix
colour_meanings.color.zone_mid: the ALARP zone of the risk matrix: reduce as far as practicable
colour_meanings.color.zone_high: the unacceptable zone of the risk matrix

/look_brief.type_ladder: built down from the densest page, the risk register beside two 5x5 matrices: nine risks with owner and mitigation fit only at 7.5pt cells, so table text is 7.5pt; footnotes and source lines a half step under at 7pt, on the absolute floor; axis and data labels and units lines at 7.5pt; every sentence, in a panel or under a table, at one body size of 8pt so prose never jumps size beside a table; run-in heads at 9pt; exhibit heads at 10.5pt in petrol; KPI figures at 20pt; an 18pt claim title that fits one line or two full ones

rejected.what: topic titles such as 'Order to cash'
rejected.why: a board pre-read is read without the speaker, so each title states the claim the page proves

rejected.what: a navy and teal 'medical' gradient band behind every title
rejected.why: it is costume: it says healthcare and carries no information, and it costs a line of title height

rejected.what: red-amber-green status colours outside the risk matrix
rejected.why: green and red would mean good and bad on one page and zone on another; burnt orange alone marks where to look

rejected.what: a colour per workstream on the roadmap
rejected.why: four hues would give colour four new meanings; the workstream is in the row label code

rejected.what: gridlines on the bridge and the matrix
rejected.why: every bar and point carries its value or code, and the matrix midlines are the only lines that mean something
a board deciding a restructuring reads them as distance from the decision
they bring two hues used nowhere else, and red beside the orange look-here colour reads as a second alarm; mid petrol up and warm grey down stay inside the palette
at 7.5pt on a laptop the pale fills washed out; the zones are the message of the risk page, so they are set at mid tone

/chrome.why: a petrol rule closes the title band, the one structural line every page shares
a hairline separates the footer from the content
the Corrin mark identifies the deck on every page

/chrome.text: Board of Directors  |  Corrin 2028 operating transformation  |  18 December 2025  |  Illustrative figures for a fictional company
/chrome.why: every page says whose pack it is, the meeting, and that its figures are illustrative
directors refer to pages by number in the meeting

/tables.why: no header fill: petrol bold heads over a petrol rule, hairlines between rows, a closing rule; dense and quiet

/charts.why: labelled marks instead of gridlines and legends; petrol leads, grey recedes, orange points

/description.summary: Clinical-plain and numerate: white pages, near-black Inter, deep petrol for Corrin's figures and target state, grey-blue for today, burnt orange only where the reader must look.
/description.typography: Inter throughout on an 18, 10.5, 9, 8, 7.5, 7pt ladder with 20pt KPI figures; one 8pt body size for every sentence; bold for titles, heads and values.
/description.color: Petrol is Corrin and the target, grey-blue is today, orange is look-here; mid petrol up and warm grey down only in the bridge; three mid-tone zone fills only in the risk matrix.
/description.layout: 0.45in margins, a kicker and claim title over a petrol rule, one dominant exhibit beside or over a supporting table, a footer with the Corrin mark.
/description.tables: No header fill, petrol bold heads over a petrol rule, hairlines between rows, a closing rule, figures right-aligned.
/description.imagery: line icons in petrol for the process steps; two inset maps drawn from public-domain outlines; no photographs
/description.motifs: the petrol title rule; numbered orange badges keyed between an exhibit and its table

/continuation.why: a page that splits repeats its title with (continued) and its table heads
